ChatGPT Artificial Intelligence

By: Hein Kaiser | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
we investigate whether the hullabaloo over AI like ChatGPT has substance, and will robots replace people sooner than we think?

Unique Selling Point:
This is a CB insert that will push the envelope visually while asking the questions that our audience wants to know about artificial intelligence, and how it may or may not impact the lives of our viewers and our immediate future. The gap between science fiction and technology has closed, and may soon overlap. We put Artificial Intelligence to the test.

Summary:
It's the stuff of science fiction….in 1966 Star Trek showed a flip phone.... in 1996 it was a reality. Domestic robots became a reality, we now have robots that clean our homes. Isaac Asimov proposed autonomous cars in 1964...Drones were first imagined in 1965 in the movie Dune....Virtual Reality was first mooted in 1935 And HAL in Space Oddysey made us all afraid of AI…..

CB investigates whether artificial intelligence can replace us, and we speak to experts who paint a picture for us of what's really happening. We also interview AI bot ChatGPT about itself, and then get the bot to write and or rewrite patrs of the script, the questions and other aspects of the insert to showcase its power.

The story will be told visually along with three primary expert case studies and a few vox pops to move the narrative forward.



Further information:
ChatGPT is a conversational AI model developed by OpenAI. It is based on the transformer architecture and was fine-tuned on a large corpus of text data from the internet. The model is capable of generating human-like responses to text inputs in a variety of languages.

The development of AI, and specifically deep learning models like ChatGPT, has been driven by advances in computer hardware and the availability of large amounts of annotated data. As more data has become available and as computing power has increased, models like ChatGPT have become larger and more sophisticated, allowing them to achieve better results on a wide range of tasks.

The future of AI is uncertain, but it is likely that models like ChatGPT will continue to improve, becoming even more human-like in their responses and capable of handling a wider range of tasks. Additionally, as AI becomes more widely adopted, it has the potential to transform many industries and aspects of our lives, from healthcare and education to entertainment and transportation.

However, the development and deployment of AI also raises important ethical and societal questions, including issues around privacy, accountability, and fairness. As AI continues to advance, it will be important to carefully consider these issues and ensure that the technology is developed and used in a responsible and ethical manner.
